front.headline: Updated From the Foundation Up
front.intro: Minutes from Downtown and EaDo, this East End bungalow has new wiring, new plumbing and a new roof. The front door opens straight into the Living Room, and a wide cased opening runs on to the Dining area, under a sputnik-style light. The open Kitchen has stainless appliances, navy and white cabinets, marble-look counters and a pantry, with a breakfast bar and a Breakfast Nook that opens to the backyard. The Primary Bedroom sits at the back with a vaulted ceiling, a beam and a double-sink bath. The hall to the other two bedrooms starts at the Dining area, every bedroom has a closet, and the hall bath and the laundry are inside the house. The yard is fenced, with a covered garage and patio out back.

top.kicker: Inside, in the order you walk it
top.title: From the Front Door to the Kitchen
top.intro: New wood-look floors run from the front door to the back of the house with no thresholds. A clerestory window high on the Living Room wall brings in daylight and keeps the room private from the street. In the Kitchen, the peninsula doubles as a breakfast bar, and the Breakfast Nook sits just past it. Everything in the Kitchen is brand new.

lead.name: Living Room
lead.text: The front door opens straight in, so there's no hall to walk through. A wide cased opening connects the room to the Dining area and the Kitchen, and the floors, trim, paint and lighting carry on without a break. Windows on the front wall face the street, and the Dining area sits right beside the room.

lead.name: Kitchen
lead.text: In an L that opens to the Dining area and the Living Room. Dark navy lowers sit under white shaker uppers, with marble-look counters and a marble-look backsplash. A stainless range sits under a chimney hood, with the sink and dishwasher beside it and the pantry just around the corner.

items.name: Front Entry
items.text: A wood door with glass at the top opens straight into the Living Room. New floors run in with no threshold, and the Kitchen's right in sight.

items.name: Dining Area
items.text: The Dining area sits between the Kitchen and the hall to the bedrooms, under a sputnik-style light, with the Living Room open on the other side.

items.name: Breakfast Bar
items.text: Two pendants hang over the peninsula, with room for stools along it. Marble-look counters run its full length, with navy cabinets below the counter.

items.name: Breakfast Nook
items.text: Windows on two walls and a door out to the backyard deck. A round table fits in the middle of the room, and the Kitchen's a few steps away.

bottom.kicker: The back half of the house
bottom.title: A Vaulted Primary at the Back

lead.name: Primary Bedroom
lead.text: Set at the back of the home, away from the street, the Primary Bedroom has a vaulted ceiling with an exposed painted beam. Windows on two walls bring in daylight, and double doors open to the closet. New carpet runs wall to wall, and there's room for a king bed and a long dresser. A doorway on the closet wall leads to the Primary Bath, and the other bedrooms are a few steps down the hall.

baths.name: Primary Bath
baths.text: A dark navy double-sink vanity sits under an LED backlit mirror. The walk-in glass shower has full-height marble-look tile, a rain showerhead and a handheld. Everything in the bath is new.

baths.name: Hall Bath
baths.text: Bedrooms 2 and 3 and guests share this bath. It has a tub with full-height marble-look tile, a pebble tile niche and a window above the tub, and it's all new. A few steps from both bedrooms.

row.name: Primary Closet
row.text: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower with hanging rods on both sides. More shelves up high hold bins or luggage, and the built-ins stay with the house, so there's nothing to buy to organize it.

row.name: Bedroom 2
row.text: Bedroom 2 sits at the front corner of the house, across from the Primary at the back. Windows on two walls bring in daylight, new carpet runs underfoot, and the room has a closet of its own.

row.name: Bedroom 3
row.text: The closet sits on the hall side, which leaves the window wall open for a desk. New carpet runs underfoot, and the room sits between Bedroom 2 and the Primary, with a window on the far wall.

back.title: The Yard, the Plan and the East End

mid.name: Covered Patio
mid.text: A covered patio runs beside the covered garage at the back of the fenced yard, with string lights already up overhead. Wood posts hold up a solid roof over a concrete floor. At about 26 feet long, it fits a long table and a seating group.

mid.name: Backyard
mid.text: Deck steps lead down from the Breakfast Nook into the fenced backyard. The covered garage (14'4" x 24'3") sits at the far end of the yard, big enough to park under or to work in. There's room beside it to park or to set up for a crowd.

xtra.name: Closet Wall
xtra.text: Double doors close off the closet on the far wall of the Primary Bedroom, with the doorway to the bath beside them. The vaulted ceiling's beam shows from here.

xtra.name: Glass Shower
xtra.text: Marble-look tile runs floor to ceiling over a pebble tile floor, with a long niche for shampoo and soap. A rain showerhead and a handheld sit behind the glass door.

rcol.head: Never flooded
rcol.text: The yard is fenced, and the fence is new. A new concrete driveway runs along the side of the house back to the covered garage, so parking's off the street and out of the way. Out front, a new walk crosses a lawn to the covered stoop, and board and batten covers the front gable. The fence closes in the yard, so the garage and the patio stay private. Both the walk and the driveway are concrete, and both Downtown and EaDo are minutes from here.
